summary: DJR's page for Forma DJR, a revival of Nebiolo's 1968 neo-grotesque, styled as a CMYK print proof: yellow, magenta and cyan panels, registration marks in every section corner and blurred halftone letters behind the prose. History chapters alternate with full-bleed colour panels of looping variable-axis word stacks (slant, width, opsz, case flips in the Mono), a misregistered 'GRaj' alternates overlay and an opsz waterfall, ending in DJR's long on-page cart with licence tiers, package previews with axis sliders and per-style checkboxes.

instances.look: On yellow, two overlapping flat rectangles, magenta (top-left) and cyan (bottom-right) with a purple overprint where they meet, carrying the hyphenated name 'for- / ma' in white hairline at ~440px and a small boxed 'DJR'; a row of four small magenta buttons (TRY, BUY, TYPESET, PDF) underneath
instances.feel: Bright, modernist, like a 1960s specimen cover
instances.ux: TRY posts a form that adds the free Testing licence to the cart; BUY jumps to #buy; TYPESET opens typeset.djr.com with the font; PDF downloads the specimen
instances.learn: Overprint two process-colour rectangles behind a hairline name: the CMYK overlap introduces the print theme of the whole page in one image

reconstruction.layout: Block 1440×735 below a 33px site header; magenta rect ~610×380 at (210,40), cyan rect ~655×350 at (574,326), overlap rendered purple (multiply); 'for-' sits in the magenta rect, 'ma' in the cyan rect, 'DJR' in a white-outlined box at the cyan rect's top-right; buttons centred at the bottom, ~56×24px each, 12px gaps
reconstruction.typography: Name ~436px Forma DJR Variable, Hairline (wght ~1), opsz 72, white, lowercase, hyphen hanging; 'DJR' ~20px Bold in a box; buttons ~10px uppercase bold white on magenta
reconstruction.behaviour: js-animated-specimen with data-slnt='0,-13' and data-wdth='100,90', data-startonload: the name slants and narrows in a loop once the page loads
reconstruction.content: Name only
reconstruction.html: section#title > div.headline-wrap.js-animated-specimen[data-slnt][data-wdth][data-startonload] > img + h1.headline > span.for + span.ma > span.djr; div.try-buy-pdf > form(commerce/cart/update-cart, fields[license]=Testing) + a.button × 3
